tool.name: Mimarks.attributes
tool.description: Reads bioSample Attributes xml and generates source for get.mimarkspackage command

regex.match: \[ERROR\]: (?!this command doesn't create a source output file|Could not open)

exit_code.description: Known upstream regression: mothur writes no source output file

has_text.text: this command doesn't create a source output file

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The ``mimarks.attributes`` command reads `BioSample Attributes`_ xml and generates source for get.mimarkspackage_ command.
.. _BioSample Attributes: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/biosample/docs/attributes/ .. _get.mimarkspackage: https://www.mothur.org/wiki/Get.mimarkspackage
.. warning::
Known upstream bug, present in every mothur release since 1.44: the ``source`` output type is never registered in the command constructor, so ``mimarks.attributes`` logs ``[ERROR]: this command doesn't create a source output file.`` followed by ``[ERROR]: Could not open`` and writes no ``*.source`` file. Upstream only needs to add ``outputTypes["source"] = tempOutNames;`` to the constructor (mothur 1.43 and earlier have it), but the line is still missing in mothur master.
Until mothur is fixed, this tool cannot produce its output: the job ends with a warning and an empty ``source`` dataset, which cannot be fed to ``get.mimarkspackage``. Use a tool version that still runs mothur <= 1.43 if you need this step.
